standard: IAMC common R10 aligned with IPCC AR6 WGIII Annex II

statuses.exact: Native geography matches the R10 definition.
statuses.aggregated: Complete native regions can be summed to R10.
statuses.approximate: A native boundary crosses R10 or membership differs.
statuses.unavailable: Source resolution cannot support a defensible mapping.

workshop_use: World is the default IAM comparison. Applied LCIA uses CH electricity and WEU steel/DAC; the native location and mapping status remain visible.
